name: @maronn-openid-connect/map-sandbox
description: The OpenID Provider the map runs a request on: the Hono OP of apps/hono with every feature, on a memory database holding the clients and users of the tests and the codes and tokens the requests of its grants issued on it (authorization, login, consent, exchange), with a clock stopped where the tests' is, bundled with the Istanbul counters the measured tests count with, so the map reads the way a request took with the rules of the test catalog
